name: trireme_v2
builder: props.trireme_v2(loc, heading_deg, oars='row'|'rest'|None, stroke_frames=34, sail='set'|None, crew='markers'|'proxies', speed_mps, bob, phoenician)
contents: 170 pivoted oars with a looping 4-phase stroke (~42/min), steering oars, square brailed linen sail, crew markers (helmsman, keleustes, bow officer, piper, 14/30 marines, 4 archers, deckhands, 170 rower seats), low-poly crew proxies for wide shots, forward motion + swell
design_source: Olympias trials (Morrison, Coates & Rankov); Xenophon Hell. 6.2.27 (sails left ashore before battle); Thucydides/Herodotus crew numbers

self_rating.notes: stroke verified catch (f1) vs finish (f16), loops exactly; look 100; SAIL not yet seen in a render (fleet_v2 stopped: low memory); crew proxies = far shots only; building is slow (~100-150 s, old trireme() makes 340 objects)
